outfit_preservation_rule: ZERO_DEFAULT_REVERSION — Both front driver and rear passenger ALWAYS preserve their currently equipped outfit, swimwear, colors, and body sliders when mounting solo or tandem bikes.
tandem_coop_lock: Tandem two-seater bikes are strictly locked unless 2-player Co-Op is active. Active bike appearance always matches the player currently in control (front seat).
